title: the document generation and the document emails

reasons.queue: The configurable queue shared example asserts the Sidekiq queue name and its SIDEKIQ_* environment switch. Tanvo's jobs run on the River queues of libs/jobs, chosen per job kind (architecture §9), with no per-kind environment switch.
reasons.tempfile: Lago renders through temporary files it must unlink. Tanvo renders in memory, and the Typst child process writes only inside the renderer's private directory, which libs/documents removes (Renderer.Close); there is no temporary file per document.
reasons.actor: No caller passes user_id or api_key_id to a mailer: the only mailer parameter beyond the document is resend: true (app/services/emails/resend_service.rb:31-47), so the email.sent log is always from the system source. Tanvo's document email jobs carry no actor; the resend status is ported (apps/server/internal/app/documents_test.go).
reasons.premium: Tanvo has no premium gates: every feature is available to every organization (the Tanvo-wide rule of docs/parity.md: no license checks in the core).
